title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00385896148992 (+0.00000827274837 over #7774)
body:
## Result

The complete multiplication application gives **conditional κ ≥ 0.00385896148992**. This is **0.00003832370815** above the directed upper endpoint of my previous contribution, PR #7756. That gain is **15.70% larger** than the preceding gain of 0.00003312268681. The point is also **0.00000827274837 above** the directed upper endpoint of the newly submitted PR #7774. Both comparisons use the new finite lower and the predecessor's upper endpoint. [Previous contribution](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7756) · [Concurrent contribution](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7774) · [Complete receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/complex/RESULT.json)

| Quantity | Verified value |
| --- | ---: |
| Ordinary BIT saving supplied by the new binary circuit | 0.00385896149 |
| Raw crossing of the complete 48-call complex invoice | [0.00385932267587, 0.00385932267588] |
| Native main fields, independent helpers, paid transfers | 400, 864, 5,701 |
| Productive / paid positions across the complete caller | 51,312 / 282,864 |

## What changed

Eight changes to causal binary senders raise the ordinary BIT saving above the previous 0.00385248 ceiling. Each trades two paid transfers for one surrendered helper. The 36-call binary invoice and two successive ordinary applications are part of the replay. [Binary construction and compiler](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/BIT-PROOF.md)

The complex circuit starts from the scientific graph in #7756. It reconstructs Clear1nsight's two published journals from #7767, then applies compatible local basis changes, two independent helper births and five paid-coordinate replacements. A closed 48-call schedule uses both ends of each mixed root for the scarce B contacts. Nine of #7774's ten paid replacements survive on the new graph. The last two symmetric bank changes use the new senders in peer edits 6 and 7 to remove transfers 101272 and 101228. The public journals supply the exact signed basis changes. [Native proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/complex/PROOF.md) · [Closed caller](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/complex/CALLER.md) · [PR #7767](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7767)

## Verification and review

From the repository root, run the registered replay with CPython 3.12 and its standard library.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-dual-supplier-lift
```

All four registered commands passed on the working tree and again from a Git-free export of the publication commit. The exporter checked 85 files and all 13 declared external inputs. The source-history check in a separate full-history clone confirmed the pinned canonical base. They cover all 1,264 native public rows, 12,705,790 exact rational coefficient products, 2,964 signed chart pairs, 1,664 port-color contacts, 840,912 caller instructions and the complete paid and productive histograms. The interval gate checks 54 strict and four functional inequalities. A separate 256-bit integer-square-root calculation confirms both complex bracket signs and the 1% improvement over #7756. The compact native graph has SHA-256 `934b7d4d792a5771bbcd28053d7797a9938f6b23faddaafe46451158eec81849`. [Commands and inputs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/VERIFY.json) · [Native and application receipts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/complex/RESULT.json)

For a small independent check, trace peer edit 1 from 99771 and 104247 through the new three-term source and its 62 terminal corrections. Its omission changes a named public coefficient. A second check is the final pair of bank changes, which add no paid transfer. The mathematical claim retains the five assumptions of native all-column realization, owned erasure, compiler correctness, precision-tape realization and analytic recovery. The verified ordinary BIT supplier limits the reported point. [Omission witnesses](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/complex/relays/OMISSIONS.json) · [Open next questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/README.md#open-next-questions)

## Assignment and attribution

The work follows priority revision 8 and the P104 side-correction task on canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The larger requested increment exceeded the selected ordinary BIT saving, which motivated the second supplier. The scoped claim recorded the comparison threshold before the result. [Coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19721588) · [Task record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/TASK.json)
